readme:
# SenangStart CSS A utility-first CSS framework that replaces abstract naming conventions with Natural Adjectives. [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE.md) ## Quick Start ### CDN (Zero Build) ```html
Hello SenangStart!
``` ### CLI ```bash npm i @bookklik/senangstart-css senangstart init # or: sen init — creates senangstart.config.mjs (.js in "type":"module" packages) senangstart dev # watch content globs + config, rebuild on change senangstart build --minify # production build (exit 1 on invalid tokens) ``` Both `senangstart` and `sen` bin aliases are available. Requires **Node ≥ 20**. Useful flags: | Flag | Purpose | |------|---------| | `-c, --config ` | Config file (relative or absolute). Missing/broken config → exit 1. Auto-discovers `senangstart.config.{js,mjs,cjs,json}` (and `.ts` on Node with type stripping). | | `-o, --output ` | CSS output path (relative or absolute) | | `--content ` | Override content globs (`!pattern` negation supported) | | `--safelist ` | Always emit these tokens, e.g. `flex p:medium visual=bg:primary` | | `--ignore-invalid` | Warn instead of failing on invalid tokens | | `--no-preflight` | Skip the base reset | | `--json` | Machine-readable build summary on stdout | | `-q, --quiet` / `--verbose` / `--no-color` | Logging control (`NO_COLOR` env is respected; warnings/errors go to stderr) | Link the generated stylesheet in your HTML: ```html ``` > The build **fails on invalid tokens** by default and prints `file:line token → message`. Use `--ignore-invalid` to warn instead. ### Configuration ```js // senangstart.config.mjs export default { content: ['./**/*.html', './resources/**/*.blade.php', '!./legacy/**'], safelist: ['flex', 'visual=bg:primary', { attr: 'space', tokens: ['p:medium'] }], output: { css: './public/senangstart.css', minify: true, aiContext: null, // opt-in: './.cursorrules' typescript: null // opt-in: './types/senang.d.ts' }, layers: true, // cascade layers (@layer) preflight: true, darkMode: 'media', // 'selector' | ['selector', '.dark'] | false build: { ignoreInvalid: false }, theme: { exposeAll: false, colors: { brand: '#38BDF8' }, // deep-merged into defaults extend: { spacing: { huge: '256px' } } // Tailwind-style extend (wins over direct keys) } }; ``` `aiContext` / `typescript` are **opt-in**. Generated files carry a `generated by SenangStart CSS` marker; an existing file without the marker is never overwritten. Unknown keys produce warnings, wrong types fail the build (`validateConfig`). ### Programmatic API (Node, ESM) ```js import { build, watch, loadConfig, defineConfig } from '@bookklik/senangstart-css/node'; const result = await build({ cwd: process.cwd(), // project root config: 'senangstart.config.mjs', // path or a config object; omit to auto-discover content: ['./src/**/*.html'], // optional override output: false, // false = don't write; string = CSS path minify: true, safelist: ['flex'] }); // result: { css, errors, warnings, files, outputs: { css?, aiContext?, typescript?, skipped }, durationMs, ok, tokenCount, config, configPath } const watcher = await watch({ cwd }, (result, error, meta) => { /* meta.event: initial|add|change|unlink|config */ }); await watcher.close(); ``` `build()` throws `ConfigError` (missing/invalid config) or `BuildError` (no sources, generation failure). The CLI is a thin wrapper over this API. Integrations: `@bookklik/senangstart-css/vite`, `@bookklik/senangstart-css/postcss`; JSON schema at `@bookklik/senangstart-css/schema`. ## Tailwind CSS Converter Migrate from Tailwind with the built-in converter (ships in the package since 0.4.0): ```bash npx senangstart convert input.html -o output.html # one file npx senangstart convert "resources/views/**/*.blade.php" --write # in place npx senangstart convert --string '
' ``` **Before (Tailwind):** ```html
``` **After (SenangStart):** ```html
``` Stacked variants, `!important`, `max-*`, `@container`, `aria-*`/`data-*`/`has-[]`, `group-*`/`peer-*`, arbitrary values and arbitrary properties are converted. Classes SenangStart cannot express stay in `class=""` and are listed at the end. Comments, ` // window.SenangStartTW.convertHTML('
Hi
') ``` ## Documentation Full docs at [bookklik-technologies.github.io/senangstart-css](https://bookklik-technologies.github.io/senangstart-css/) ## License Read [MIT License](LICENSE.md)
